update_url: Update the URL when the input or recipe changes
show_highlighter: Highlight selected bytes in output and input (when possible)
word_wrap: Word wrap the input and output
error_timeout: Operation error timeout in ms (0 for never)
auto_magic: Attempt to detect encoded data automagically
image_preview: Render a preview of the input if it's detected to be an image
sync_tabs: Keep the current tab in sync between the input and output
show_cat_count: Show the number of operations in each category
persist_notice: Please note that these options will persist between sessions.
